title: Joshua prepares the people to cross the Jordan
description: Joshua commands the leaders of the people to prepare provisions, for in three days they will cross the Jordan to take possession of the land. He reminds the Reubenites, Gadites, and half-tribe of Manasseh of Moses' command: their armed men must cross ahead of their brothers and help them until they also find rest, before returning to their own land east of the Jordan. The people promise to obey Joshua just as they obeyed Moses.
